findings.claim: Public modern input is a pinned serialized pollen_climate object, directly loaded by the author reproduction script; package data bytes agree at the two inspected revisions.
findings.limit: Does not prove historical runtime, full author output reproduction or sample origin.

findings.claim: Y is 7832x28 in R integer storage; X is 7832x8 real storage, both with only column dimnames; column labels recorded.
findings.limit: Integer storage does not prove original grain counts, nonnegativity, completeness, N_original or measured zero status. No numeric cell values or summaries inspected.

findings.claim: Author documentation calls Y compositional pollen counts and describes uppermost 5-10 mm lake sediment and station-weighted climate over approximately 30 years.
findings.limit: Documentation and generated Rd are one source lineage, not independent evidence. No sample-specific collection/deposition dates, integration duration, exact calendar normal period or station build manifest proven.

findings.claim: The serialized object contains only Y and X with names/dim/dimnames attributes. Both matrices have NULL row dimnames. No separate sample-ID, source, collection-date, uncertainty, sample-context or N field is present.
findings.limit: Row order supplies author-intended within-object pairing, not an external identity key. This does not establish that no separate public provenance table exists elsewhere.

findings.claim: Original sample IDs and source/collection groups, row-metadata binding, exact climate period/source and observation/zero/denominator rules remain needed before a real input decision.
findings.limit: No linkage to EMPD2, external sample source, or fossil concepts inferred. No real E selection or use permitted from this check.
